narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to our advanced quiz on Control and Coordination. This section will challenge your understanding with some thought-provoking questions. Let's see how well you've grasped the concepts. Are you ready? Here is your first question. What is the function of receptors in our body? Think of situations where receptors do not work properly. What problems are likely to arise? Take a moment to think about this. And the answer is: All information from the environment is detected by receptors. If they don't work, our body can't detect environmental changes and respond. Moving on to the next question. Draw the structure of a neuron and explain its function. This requires you to recall the parts of a neuron and their roles. Here's the explanation: Information is acquired at the dendrite tip, travels as an electrical impulse through the cell body and axon. Now for a question about plants. How does phototropism occur in plants? Remember the role of plant hormones here. The answer involves plant hormones like Auxin, Gibberellins, Cytokinin, and Abscisic acid, which control growth, cell division, and inhibit growth. And finally, our last question for this quiz. Which signals will get disrupted in case of a spinal cord injury? Consider the pathways involved in different types of actions. The correct answer is: In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted. This is because the spinal cord monitors and controls these actions. Great job everyone! I hope this quiz helped solidify your understanding of Control and Coordination. Keep practicing!

visual_beats.description: Title: Advanced Quiz: Control and Coordination
Question: What is the function of receptors in our body? Think of situations where receptors do not work properly. What problems are likely to arise?
Answer: All information from environment is detected by receptors. When receptors do not work properly then information from environment cannot be detected and our body cannot respond accordingly.
Question: Draw the structure of neuron and explain its function.

Answer: (i) The information is acquired at the end of the dendrite tip of a nerve cell (ii) The information travels as an electrical impulse from the dendrite to the cell body and then along the axon to its end.
Question: How does phototropism occur in plants?

Answer: The chemical compounds released by stimulated cells for control and coordination in plants are called plant hormones or phytohormones. Auxin: Controls growth; Gibberellins: Helps in growth of stem; Cytokinin: Promotes cell division; Abscisic acid: Inhibits growth, wilting of leaves.
Question: Which signals will get disrupted in case of spinal cord injury?

Answer: In case of a spinal cord injury, signals for reflex action and involuntary action will get disrupted. Reflex actions are monitored and controlled through the spinal cord of nervous system and not by the brain. In fact, nerves from all over the body meet in a bundle in the spinal cord on their way to the brain. In case of any injury to the spinal cord, the signals coming from the nerves as well as signals coming to the receptors will be disrupted.
